title: Grateful Dead Live at Robertson Gym, U.C.S.B. on 1969-05-29
lineage: SBD > MR > PCM > DAT > CD > EAC > WAV > shntool > SHN

ai_review.summary: Energetic 1969 show that many fans love, but the recording is plagued by cassette‑generation loss and questionable source authenticity.
ai_review.review: The performances are described as fun, high‑energy and "rockin' hot," with several reviewers calling it a great live Dead show. However, most listeners complain about the audio – citing multiple cassette generations, poor fidelity and even doubts about the tape’s provenance – making the recording far from pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (6 of 8) gave low or zero stars, focusing on poor sound quality and source issues, while a few praised the performance. Weighted averaging of show vs. recording points to an overall rating just below average.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners report at least two cassette generations in the mix, muffled/low‑fidelity sound, and uncertainty about the actual concert date; some claim the tape is a duplicate or spurious.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific setlist commentary; reviewers speak generally of a fun, high‑energy performance despite technical woes.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned as being disgusted with the PA/sound system and frustrated by poor monitoring.
